meta.name: lark-workflow-standup-report
meta.description: 日程待办摘要：编排 calendar +agenda 和 task +get-my-tasks，生成指定日期的日程与未完成任务摘要。适用于了解今天/明天/本周的安排。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动汇总日程与待办，生成每日工作摘要
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每天需要快速了解当日日程和未完成任务
copy.tagline_en: Automatically summarize calendar and tasks for daily standup
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a quick daily summary of your schedule and pending tasks

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会调用 lark-cli 读取你的日历日程与未完成待办，汇总成指定日期的摘要，给出日程表、待办清单，并提示时间冲突与空闲时段。
howto.when: 当你问「今天有什么安排」「明天有什么会」「这周还有哪些安排」等、想了解某天日程和待办时触发。仅支持 user 身份，需先授权 calendar、task。

say.text: 帮我看看今天有什么安排和没做完的事
say.note: 会拉取当天日程与未完成待办并汇总

say.text: 明天有什么会？再列出到期的未完成任务

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude runs lark-cli to pull your calendar events and open tasks, then writes a summary for a given date: schedule table, to-do list, plus conflict and free-slot notes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask about today's, tomorrow's or this week's plans, e.g. "what's on today" or "any meetings tomorrow". User identity only; authorize calendar and task first.

say_en.text: Show me today's schedule and unfinished tasks
say_en.note: Pulls today's events and open tasks

say_en.text: What meetings do I have tomorrow, plus due tasks?
say_en.note: Builds the summary for a given date

say_en.text: What's left on my calendar this week?
say_en.note: Summarizes this week's events and tasks
